problem.text: Requests are often routed to the wrong department, causing delays and manual rerouting by reviewers. There is no measurement of how often this occurs, and the process is inefficient.

goals.text: Reduce the time requests sit before reaching the correct team.
Provide reviewers with advisory triage recommendations that include the rationale and cited policy IDs.
Ensure all recommendations and lookups are auditable.
Support both English and French for Montréal office users.

requirements.text: The assistant must provide advisory routing and priority suggestions for each new request, including a rationale and the policy IDs and versions cited.
Reviewers must confirm or override the assistant's suggestion; automatic routing without confirmation is not allowed.
The system must audit every recommendation and lookup, recording who asked, when, and what was returned.
If a request is rerouted after a suggestion, the UI must indicate that the suggestion is stale.
The assistant must support both English and French.

outOfScope.text: Automatic approval or routing of requests without reviewer confirmation.

successMeasures.text: The share of requests rerouted after triage, measured for two weeks before and after the assistant is enabled.

epic.title: Assisted Request Triage
epic.summary: Implement an advisory assistant that recommends routing and priority for incoming requests, with rationale and policy citations, supporting audit, reviewer confirmation, and bilingual operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new request, When the assistant generates a recommendation, Then the reviewer sees the suggested department, priority, rationale, and cited policy IDs.
Given a reviewer confirms or overrides a suggestion, When the action is taken, Then the event is recorded in the audit log.
Given a request is rerouted after a suggestion, When a reviewer views the request, Then the UI indicates the suggestion is stale.
Given the assistant is unavailable, When a reviewer opens a request, Then the panel shows an unavailable message and manual routing stays enabled.

tasks.title: Implement Assistant Recommendation Engine
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to generate advisory routing and priority suggestions for new requests, including rationale and policy citations.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new request, When the backend receives the request data, Then it returns a suggested department, priority, rationale, and policy IDs.
Given a request with missing or unclear information, When the assistant cannot determine a department, Then it marks the request for human review and asks a clarifying question.
Given a request that matches multiple policies, When the assistant generates a suggestion, Then it cites all relevant policy IDs and versions.

tasks.title: Reviewer Confirmation and Override UI
tasks.description: Build the frontend panel for reviewers to confirm or override assistant suggestions, with rationale and policy citations visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer opens a request, When a suggestion is available, Then the panel displays the suggested department, priority, rationale, and policy IDs.
Given a reviewer confirms a suggestion, When the action is taken, Then only one audit entry and one notification are created even if the button is double-clicked.
Given a reviewer overrides a suggestion, When the override is submitted, Then the UI updates to show the new routing and marks the suggestion as stale.

tasks.title: Audit Logging for Recommendations and Lookups
tasks.description: Extend the audit history to record every recommendation and lookup, including who asked, when, and what was returned.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer requests a recommendation, When the assistant responds, Then the audit log records the user, timestamp, and recommendation details.
Given a reviewer confirms or overrides a suggestion, When the action is taken, Then the audit log records the event with user and timestamp.
Given an audit entry is created, When a reviewer double-clicks the confirmation, Then only one entry is recorded.

tasks.title: Bilingual Support and Assistant Availability Handling
tasks.description: Ensure the assistant and UI support both English and French, and clearly indicate when the assistant is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reviewer opens a request, When the assistant is available, Then the UI displays all suggestions and rationale in the user's preferred language.
Given a reviewer opens a request, When the assistant is unavailable, Then the panel shows an unavailable message and allows manual routing.
Given a reviewer uses the Montréal office locale, When the assistant generates a suggestion, Then the suggestion and rationale are shown in French.

openQuestions.question: What is the agreed definition of 'fast' for assistant response time?
Who is allowed to override a suggestion: only reviewers, or approvers as well?
How long should recommendations (not decisions) be retained in the audit log?
What confidence score threshold, if any, should hide a suggestion from reviewers?

conflicts.summary: Ava wants automatic routing when the assistant is confident, but Priya and policy POL-GOV-001 require reviewer confirmation for all suggestions.
conflicts.resolution: Automatic routing is out of scope for this release; only recommendations with reviewer confirmation are allowed.

conflicts.summary: POL-ROUTE-004 requires expensive requests to go to Finance, but Ben and POL-ROUTE-001 state that IT owns all computing equipment regardless of cost.

decisions.decision: The first release delivers recommendations plus reviewer confirmation; no automatic routing without a person confirming.
